hero.title: Your Rights. Your Voice. A Stronger Gram Panchayat.
hero.subtitle: Access government welfare schemes, understand your statutory rights, report corruption, and track official accountability through one simple, secure platform.

problem.title: Bridging The Citizen-Administration Gap
problem.desc: In many villages, citizens face structural barriers accessing benefits and seeking accountability. GramSaksham builds institutional transparency directly for rural families.
problem.item1Desc: Demands for cash signatures on housing installments and certificates go unreported due to fear of retribution.
problem.item2Desc: Eligible families living in kutcha homes are arbitrarily dropped from beneficiary lists without written reasons.
problem.item3Desc: Citizens do not know that grievances against Panchayat representatives must be filed with the Block Development Officer or Vigilance.
problem.item4Desc: Submitted applications and complaints disappear into offline files without receipt numbers or status timelines.

gramConnect.title: GramConnect
gramConnect.desc: Verified welfare scheme discovery and rule-based eligibility assessment engine with document checklists.

smartPanchayat.title: Smart Panchayat
smartPanchayat.desc: Secure corruption reporting, automated conflict-of-interest flagging, and public status tracking timeline.

jalWatch.title: JalWatch
jalWatch.desc: Village drinking water supply monitoring, broken handpump alerts, and pipeline repair dispatch.

workVerify.title: WorkVerify AI
workVerify.desc: Public infrastructure monitoring with geotagged progress photos and independent human verification.

krishiAlert.title: KrishiAlert
krishiAlert.desc: Localized weather forecasts, rabi/kharif crop disease alerts, and agricultural subsidy notices for Chandil.

howItWorks.title: Accountable Governance in 4 Clear Steps
howItWorks.step1Desc: Answer simple household questions to know your statutory eligibility under PMAY-G, SBM-G, or Abua Awas.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Report bribery, extortion, or unjustified exclusion with optional proof and confidentiality safeguards.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Complaints against local representatives are routed directly to the BDO Chandil or ACB Vigilance, never to the accused.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Follow every step of investigation, review official Action Taken Reports (ATR), and reopen if unsatisfied.

trust.title: Built on Trust, Privacy and Rule of Law
trust.point1: Conflict-of-Interest Safeguard: Accused officials can never review or suppress complaints against themselves.
trust.point2: Data Minimization: Confidential and anonymous options protect citizen identities from local retaliation.
trust.point3: Legal Clarity: Internal complaint logging is transparently marked and routed to authorized statutory desks.
trust.point4: Verifiable Rules: Scheme eligibility uses official Central & Jharkhand Gazettes without invented metrics.
